work.title: Romeo and Juliet
work.note: Peça de William Shakespeare sobre dois jovens de famílias rivais que se apaixonam em Verona. É uma das histórias de amor mais conhecidas do mundo. Na aula, Mia fala de um jantar romântico: I’m going to wear my red dress. A cena desta aula é original; não reproduz a obra.

facts.label: Going to e passado simples
facts.sub: Use going to para planos: I’m going to wear my red dress. Use o passado para fatos: We went there last month. I bought it last week.

facts.label: Going to
facts.sub: Para falar de planos, use am/is/are going to + verbo: I’m going to have dinner with Tom. Pergunte What are you going to do? e responda com o dia ou a hora.

facts.label: Passado simples
facts.sub: Para falar do que já aconteceu, use o passado: invited, loved. Irregulares mudam: go vira went, buy vira bought, bring vira brought. Use last week e yesterday.

pages.title: A small cafe · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday afternoon in a small cafe in Glasgow. Rain hits the window. Mia sits with a cup of tea. Her friend Edith comes in with a big smile. Valentine’s Day is on Saturday. Edith asks about the plans.

“Hi, Mia! What are you going to do on Valentine’s Day?” says Edith. “I’m going to have dinner with Tom. Yesterday he called me and invited me.” says Mia. “Oh, nice! Where are you going to eat?” says Edith.
